title: Mascot crew (umbrella): names, registry, chat presence, animations
description: Umbrella over MPI-843, MPI-842 and MPI-777. Names the five mascots, puts one registry file behind them, and gives the agent chat a crew presence where Cosmo is the only speaker. UNBLOCKED 2026-09-21 (Fabio): the blocker was "until the clips are rolled to GIF", and they are - 103 GIFs delivered in the Vision project `Cubric Studio GIFs`, 84 with transparency and 19 opaque transition clips that are MEANT to be opaque (rendered on black, composited with mix-blend-mode: screen). Measured 2026-09-21: all 103 are 10fps, 98 at 768x768, median 2.5 MB, 0.32 GB total, and the cut-out alpha is 1-BIT - hard edges, zero partial alpha values. So they are USABLE but not yet SHIPPABLE: they need downscaling to display size whatever the format, and the 1-bit edge is the open question the alpha WebM export in MPI-777 Settled was meant to answer. That decision is deliberately deferred - MPI-777 Phase 2 is format-agnostic behind heroCrew._poseSrc, so the queue gets built and watched first, then the format is chosen. Phases and parallel batches in plan.md.
